motions.name: context-lever
motions.trigger: Draft Reply or Create Task state change
motions.pendingReview: Pulse the status point between 55% and 100% opacity every 900ms; do not move the lever again.

motions.name: gauge-sweep
motions.trigger: Unread count, schedule load, or sync progress changes

motions.name: codex-drum
motions.effect: Translate selected label vertically 8px to 0 while fading from 60% to 100%; neighboring labels move in the opposite direction.

motions.name: sync-gears
motions.effect: Rotate paired gears continuously in opposite directions. Stop on success; reverse 18deg once on error.

motions.name: tank-energy
motions.trigger: Ambient while viewport is at least 1180px wide
motions.effect: Animate a cyan highlight pseudo-element from translateY(18%) to translateY(-18%) and opacity .16 to .32. Four bubble fields rise through the glass on a separate 5600ms linear cycle. Do not animate the PNG itself.

motions.name: tool-active
motions.effect: Increase bronze logo brightness from 78% to 100%, raise module 2px, and add a 14px ember glow.

motions.name: mic-pressure-vent
motions.effect: Retain the existing pressure-vent animation. The supplied mic orb is only the new shell.

motions.name: reactor-rings
motions.trigger: Ambient; accelerate while listening or processing
motions.effect: Rotate two visibly toothed DOM gear rings above the static reactor bezel. Accelerate both while listening or processing. Never rotate the photoreal reactor asset itself.

motions.name: console-control
motions.trigger: Pointer hover, press, or selected mode
motions.effect: Each of the six responsive DOM modules owns its mechanism and hit target. Raise 2px on hover, depress 2px on click, and add an ember indicator glow for the selected mode. Studio gears rotate at 4.5s idle at the shipped tile size (the original 14s was written for a large studio gear and reads as motionless once cropped to a dock tile); the Studio linkage lever throws to -8deg and back over 420ms, on a 9s idle cycle as well as on press (the -8deg is the artwork's own ceiling: past ~10deg the moving mask erases the hanger painted above the vessel, and an on-press-only throw is one nobody sees, because that press also changes the view) and the reactor core breathes on the 4200ms ambient cadence. Since 2026-10-15 the dock is OPS, Caption Studio, Knowledge Graph, Google Drive, FareHarbor, Projects: the Knowledge Graph core glows like a furnace (5600ms swell plus a 3700ms flicker of a few percent, screen-blended light only); the FareHarbor ship's wheel spins three turns (1080deg) over 3.6s with a long ease-out, lands exactly on its start pose and rests 5s (8.6s cycle), as a masked copy clipped at r=70.5 around the rim-fitted centre (104.19,108.37); the Google Drive tile keeps the gauge bezel and swaps the dial face for an opaque engraved plate with a 7s light sweep. As built 2026-09-21 the raster is not a rail at all: each button carries its own proportionally cropped tile at full opacity, never stretched, and every moving part is either light composited to brighten only, or a masked copy of the tile's own pixels that covers the still artwork. Nothing draws a second outline of a painted mechanism.

reducedMotion: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, disable continuous tank and gear animation; snap lever, drum, and needle state changes in 1ms.
